findings.text: the FlightConfigError branch records status refused with run_id None, so _repair_in_flight (recovery.py:1700) finds no standing repair and the round stays free; a project with a persistently malformed review.suite then has the reflex recompose a node and re-record a refusal, incrementing attempt, on every sweep cadence, where its sibling refusals either resolve on a promotion or never recur.

item_verdicts.diff: read git show 8c6295e against base 6f17d5c4b - two files, 104 insertions and 13 deletions; recovery.py removes the try/except at the helper (now declaration = flight.review_suite(config)) and adds a FlightConfigError catch at recovery.py:2045 that records status refused and returns the same report shape its sibling refusal branches return; the test file adds three cases; no unrelated edit.
item_verdicts.done_when: the review round required each actionable finding repaired with its own demonstration; the repair adds test_a_malformed_standing_suite_is_refused_by_name and test_the_reflex_refuses_a_malformed_standing_suite_without_dispatching, plus test_an_undeclared_standing_suite_is_no_command preserving the absence path; the manifest's base arm reads 4 passed and after arm 7 passed (EXIT=0 both), reproduced here at head 8c6295e as 7 passed EXIT=0, and the declared negative control reddens both new checks (2 failed, EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal: the dispatched goal was to answer the review of r-20260930T195433561538-repair-carries-the-suite-pair, which left two findings; the actionable one (reckon/crew/recovery.py:1769, a bare except around flight.review_suite that swallowed the FlightConfigError a malformed standing review.suite raises by design, converting a refusal into a silent absence) is repaired at recovery.py:2043-2061, where the helper no longer catches, the refusal propagates, and dispatch_repair_for_run catches FlightConfigError, records a refusal against the reviewed run and returns without launching.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names commit 8c6295e, the answering helper change, the declined second finding with its reason, tests, both arm logs and the negative control; it records baseline_suite (revision 6f17d5c4b, arm-base.log, 4 passed) and after_suite (revision 8c6295e, arm-head.log, 7 passed) with completed true, so this review's added-failure count derives a measured zero.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the grant is reckon/crew/recovery.py, tests/test_repair_skips_out_of_repo_findings.py, an evidence fragment and a figures directory; the single commit touches only the first two, both inside the grant; the evidence fragment and figures directory are explicitly left unused because the done-when names no artifact.

justifications.durability: the two new checks redden against the reverted helper and pass at head, and the undeclared path is pinned by its own case, so a regression that re-swallows the refusal fails; deducted because a malformed standing suite is a persistent project-config state and the refusal it now records leaves the round free - _record_repair_dispatch stamps run_id None, so _repair_in_flight finds no standing repair and the next sweep recomposes and re-records the refusal on every cadence, the same re-attempt pattern the reflex guards exist to bound.
justifications.evidence: the reviewed manifest records the suite pair with completed true and both logs read EXIT=0 (arm-base.log 4 passed at 6f17d5c4b, arm-head.log 7 passed at 8c6295e), the head arm was independently reproduced here (7 passed, EXIT=0), and the negative control reddens both new checks (2 failed, EXIT=1); deducted because the base arm ran in a scratch tree that no longer exists, so its 4-passed count is read from the log rather than re-run.
justifications.fit: the repair reuses flight.review_suite and the surrounding refusal idiom (status refused through the existing _record_repair_dispatch), returning the same report shape as the sibling launch-refusal and CrewError branches and naming no plan or version token; deducted because the malformed-suite refusal re-fires per sweep rather than marking the round settled, so the branch reaches slightly beyond the reliable-refusal behaviour its siblings share.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the actionable finding is answered exactly - recovery.py:1769's bare except is gone, flight.review_suite's refuse-by-name contract is restored at the helper, and dispatch_repair_for_run catches FlightConfigError at recovery.py:2045, records the refusal against the reviewed run and returns without launching, while an undeclared suite still yields the empty string (test_an_undeclared_standing_suite_is_no_command); the second finding is declined with a reason verified against the reviewed manifest, which carries no baseline_suite or after_suite line and so cannot be amended here.
justifications.scope_discipline: one commit, two changed paths, both inside the declared grant; the commit carries a conventional subject and a body with no AI trailer and no plan or sprint identifier; ruff reports 6 findings across the two files at head and 6 at base, so the change adds none; no plan state, index or peer-owned file is touched.
